comment.text: Morning pack 2026-11-18: DELIVERED. Report filed at evidence/graveyard-2026-11-17/dell-nik/KH-7-tailscale-report.md (verified vs brief in VERIFICATION.md). Headline: any local process on dell-nik can read the full fleet peer map via tailscale status --json (world-rw tailscaled socket); visibility is not connectivity and ACLs alone do not hide the map. Ranked KinOS fix #1: OS-boundary isolation from the host daemon. Research only, no Tailscale changes. Held for Nik: KinOS isolation posture decision at design time.

issue.title: Control-ceiling follow-up: Tailscale peer visibility exposure
issue.description: tailscale status exposes the whole fleet's names/addresses to any user-level process (ceiling test finding 1). Document the exposure precisely; propose mitigations (ACLs, peer segmentation) for Nik's decision. No changes without his word.
